"""Baseline tests for the verifiable audit log."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

from auditlog import AuditLog, EntryNotFound, InvalidRequest, inclusion_proof, merkle_root, verify_inclusion


class MerkleUnitTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_log_has_zero_root(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(merkle_root([]), "0" * 64)

    def test_root_changes_with_every_appended_entry(self) -> None:
        log = AuditLog()
        roots = [log.root()["root"]]
        for i in range(5):
            log.append({"n": i})
            roots.append(log.root()["root"])
        self.assertEqual(len(set(roots)), len(roots))

    def test_inclusion_proof_verifies_for_every_index_and_odd_sizes(self) -> None:
        log = AuditLog()
        for i in range(7):
            log.append({"n": i, "note": "x" * i})
        size = log.size()
        self.assertEqual(size, 7)
        for index in range(size):
            proof = log.proof(index)
            self.assertTrue(verify_inclusion(proof["entry_hash"], proof["proof"], proof["root"]),
                            f"index {index} must verify")
            self.assertEqual(proof["size"], size)

    def test_tampered_proof_or_entry_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        log = AuditLog()
        for i in range(4):
            log.append({"n": i})
        proof = log.proof(2)
        self.assertFalse(verify_inclusion("f" * 64, proof["proof"], proof["root"]))
        broken = [dict(step) for step in proof["proof"]]
        if broken:
            broken[0]["hash"] = "e" * 64
            self.assertFalse(verify_inclusion(proof["entry_hash"], broken, proof["root"]))
        self.assertFalse(verify_inclusion(proof["entry_hash"], proof["proof"], "a" * 64))

    def test_entry_hash_commits_to_previous_entry(self) -> None:
        log = AuditLog()
        first = log.append({"n": 1})
        second = log.append({"n": 2})
        self.assertEqual(second.prev_hash, first.hash)
        self.assertEqual(first.prev_hash, "0" * 64)

    def test_invalid_payloads_and_indices(self) -> None:
        log = AuditLog()
        for bad in [None, "", 3, b"bytes", []]:
            if bad == []:
                continue          # [] is a legal JSON array payload
            with self.assertRaises(InvalidRequest):
                log.append(bad)
        log.append({"n": 1})
        with self.assertRaises(EntryNotFound):
            log.entry(5)
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidRequest):
            log.entry(-1)
        with self.assertRaises(EntryNotFound):
            inclusion_proof(["a" * 64], 3)


class HttpSurfaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        from auditlog import serve

        cls.server = serve(port=0)
        cls.port = cls.server.server_address[1]
        threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.server.shutdown()

    def call(self, method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None):
        data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
        request = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}{path}", data=data, method=method,
                                         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                return response.status, json.loads(response.read() or b"{}")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            return error.code, json.loads(error.read() or b"{}")

    def test_health_append_root_entry_and_proof(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET", "/health")[0], 200)
        status, body = self.call("POST", "/v1/entries", {"payload": {"action": "login"}})
        self.assertEqual((status, body["size"]), (201, 1))
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/v1/entries", {"payload": {"action": "logout"}})[1]["size"], 2)
        root_body = self.call("GET", "/v1/root")[1]
        self.assertEqual(root_body["size"], 2)
        entry = self.call("GET", "/v1/entries/0")[1]
        proof = self.call("GET", "/v1/proof/inclusion/0")[1]
        self.assertTrue(verify_inclusion(entry["hash"], proof["proof"], root_body["root"]))

    def test_errors(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET", "/v1/entries/99")[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/v1/entries", {"payload": None})[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET", "/nope")[0], 404)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

2	
3	Public contract is README.md. Entries are chained (each entry commits to the previous entry hash) and the
4	log publishes a Merkle root with inclusion proofs so a third party can verify a single entry offline.
5	"""

8	import hashlib
9	import json
10	import threading
11	from dataclasses import dataclass
12	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
13	from typing import Any

16	class AuditError(Exception):
17	    code = "internal_error"
18	    status = 500
19	
20	
21	class InvalidRequest(AuditError):
22	    code, status = "invalid_request", 400
23	
24	
25	class EntryNotFound(AuditError):
26	    code, status = "not_found", 404
27

29	def sha256_hex(*parts: bytes) -> str:
30	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
31	    for part in parts:
32	        digest.update(part)
33	    return digest.hexdigest()
34	
35	
36	def leaf_hash(payload: Any) -> str:
37	    canonical = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
38	    return sha256_hex(b"\x00", canonical)
39	
40	
41	def node_hash(left: str, right: str) -> str:
42	    return sha256_hex(b"\x01", left.encode(), right.encode())
43	
44	
45	def merkle_root(leaves: list[str]) -> str:
46	    """Bitcoin-style: a level with an odd node duplicates its last node. Empty log has the zero root."""
47	    if not leaves:
48	        return "0" * 64
49	    level = list(leaves)
50	    while len(level) > 1:
51	        if len(level) % 2:
52	            level.append(level[-1])
53	        level = [node_hash(level[i], level[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(level), 2)]
54	    return level[0]
55	
56	
57	def inclusion_proof(leaves: list[str], index: int) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
58	    if not 0 <= index < len(leaves):
59	        raise EntryNotFound(f"no entry at index {index}")
60	    proof: list[dict[str, str]] = []
61	    level, position = list(leaves), index
62	    while len(level) > 1:
63	        if len(level) % 2:
64	            level.append(level[-1])
65	        sibling = position + 1 if position % 2 == 0 else position - 1
66	        proof.append({"position": "right" if position % 2 == 0 else "left", "hash": level[sibling]})
67	        level = [node_hash(level[i], level[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(level), 2)]
68	        position //= 2
69	    return proof

72	def verify_inclusion(entry_hash: str, proof: list[dict[str, str]], root: str) -> bool:
73	    if not isinstance(entry_hash, str) or len(entry_hash) != 64 or not isinstance(proof, list) or not isinstance(root, str):
74	        return False
75	    current = entry_hash
76	    for step in proof:
77	        if not isinstance(step, dict) or step.get("position") not in {"left", "right"} or not isinstance(step.get("hash"), str):
78	            return False
79	        current = node_hash(current, step["hash"]) if step["position"] == "right" else node_hash(step["hash"], current)
80	    return current == root

import json, threading, urllib.request
from auditlog import serve, verify_inclusion

srv = serve(port=0)
port = srv.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

def get(path):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}", timeout=5) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read())

def post(payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1/entries",
                                 data=json.dumps({"payload": payload}).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        return r.status

for i in range(25):
    post({"i": i})

# page through snapshot 25 with limit 10, verifying every item
start, seen, root0 = 0, [], None
while True:
    st, b = get(f"/v1/proofs/inclusion?snapshot_size=25&start={start}&limit=10")
    assert st == 200, b
    root0 = root0 or b["root"]
    assert b["root"] == root0
    for p in b["proofs"]:
        assert p["size"] == 25 and verify_inclusion(p["entry_hash"], p["proof"], b["root"])
        seen.append(p["index"])
    if b["next_start"] is None:
        break
    start = b["next_start"]
assert seen == list(range(25)), seen
print("pagination+verify OK, pages end at start", start)

# empty boundary page
st, b = get("/v1/proofs/inclusion?snapshot_size=25&start=25&limit=10")
assert (b["count"], b["proofs"], b["next_start"]) == (0, [], None)
print("boundary empty page OK")

# concurrency: old snapshot 25 must stay identical while appending
_, before = get("/v1/proofs/inclusion?snapshot_size=25&start=0&limit=100")
def churn():
    for i in range(25, 200):
        post({"i": i})
t = threading.Thread(target=churn); t.start()
roots = set()
import time
end = time.time() + 1.0
while time.time() < end:
    _, b = get("/v1/proofs/inclusion?snapshot_size=25&start=7&limit=10")
    roots.add(b["root"])
t.join()
_, after = get("/v1/proofs/inclusion?snapshot_size=25&start=0&limit=100")
assert roots == {before["root"]} and after == before
st, b = get("/v1/root")
assert b["size"] == 200
print("concurrent-append stability OK, final log size", b["size"])
srv.shutdown()
EOF
